text:
The tone of the email is polite and professional, but it is somewhat abrupt and lacks specific details that would strengthen the request. To improve it, you should add a specific new deadline you are proposing, briefly mention the nature of the circumstances (without oversharing), and express gratitude for the professor's consideration.

Here is a revised version with a more respectful and persuasive tone:

Dear Professor Smith,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to respectfully request an extension on my term paper deadline. I fully understand the importance of adhering to deadlines; however, due to unforeseen personal circumstances, I have been unable to complete the paper by the original due date.

I am committed to submitting high-quality work and would greatly appreciate it if I could extend the deadline to [Insert New Date]. Thank you for your time and understanding.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]

Australia
